meta.title: An event with a submitted proposal cannot be withdrawn

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still active (nothing changed).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Cannot withdraw the event as proposals are already submitted.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still active (nothing changed).

plan.title: An event with a submitted proposal cannot be withdrawn

assert.say: the event is still active (nothing changed)

expected.message: Cannot withdraw the event as proposals are already submitted.
